newsitem.title: USA: Lindsay sees Q4 EPS of $0.35-$0.37.
newsitem.headline: Lindsay sees Q4 EPS of $0.35-$0.37.

text.p: Lindsay Manufaturing Co said Thursday it expected to report per-share earnings for the its fiscal fourth quarter in a range of $0.35 to $0.37.
The company, a manufacturer of irrigation systems, said it expected to report results for the quarter ended August 31 next week. In the year-earlier period, it posted earnings of $0.27 per share.
Per-share figures reflect a February 1996 three-for-two stock split.
The company also expects fourth-quarter revenue between $28 million and $30 million, up from $21.9 million in the same year-earlier period.
